newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary sees 12-13 mln tonnes grain crop-ministry.
newsitem.headline: Hungary sees 12-13 mln tonnes grain crop-ministry.

text.p: Hungary's total grains crop is expected to be between 12 million and 13 million tonnes, the Agriculture Ministry (FM) said on Monday.
"Harvesting remains the only question mark," Gyula Ocsodi, FM Deputy State Secretary told Reuters.
Most industry sources agreed that rains over the last month caused almost a two-week delay in harvesting.

Ocsodi added that with some 45 to 50 percent of the wheat harvested, the ministry maintained its forecast of five million tonnes for this year, up from last year's 3.9 million. Barring further rains, wheat harvesting would be completed within 8 to 10 days, he said, adding that quality could suffer from persistent moisture.
